capabilities: Generate titles for untitled notes via Groq chat completions
Extract titles offline from headings or phrases without an API key
Rename note files in place with Obsidian link updating
Exclude journals, templates, hidden folders, and opted-out notes
Undo the last generated title rename
extras: Requires an Obsidian desktop 1.13+ environment variable (GROQ_API_KEY) rather than a settings field, with a Windows installer and build-provenance attestations for releases; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: New notes sit with placeholder names like Untitled or Untitled-1 until the user manually writes and renames them.
summary: Renames untitled notes with concise content-based titles, generated by Groq or extracted locally offline.
